text.text_excerpt: This place would get 5 stars if it was non-smoking. I love that Bridge Lounge makes plenty of mojitos and even tops off the mojitos with *champagne* wink, wink ;) (that's only for the top shelf version which is $1 I believe). You can get it with coconut rum, or all kinds of flavors and they are all good. Sometimes there is free food. I love the interior and the ambiance, reminds me of being home in NYC. I love the wood on the ceilings, the lighting, the candles, the bar's stone counter top... I love it all. I love that you can bring your dog. I have yet to bring Ophie but I see it in our future.

Nice place to relax, my friend has a little dog who she hates leaving at home after being at work all day, and this place is a doggy friendly bar so we get to go there and hang out. Their Mojitos are pretty good, and it is reasonably priced. It's a great atmosphere over all.

I much liked this joint back when I lived in NOLA so I'm here to reminiscent about it. One of the pros of this place - it's dog friendly. I don't own a dog, but I sure as heck love cuddling the daylights out of strangers' dogs. No rabies yet, so I will continue to engage in this bizarre practice. Anyway, the actual structure is pretty spacious - there's a separate little room you can reserve for banquets - which is pretty snazzy. My alma mater had a festive graduation shindig there a few couple of years ago and I really rather enjoyed it.
